title: Chapter 1415
text:
Just as everyone was having their own thoughts, the body of the Supreme Heavenly Venerate on the battlefield shrank, and the mechanical soldiers returned to Han Xiao's body, revealing his original figure.

Han Xiao looked at the spot where EsGod had died, and a glint flashed across his eyes.

Just as he was emptying EsGod's health, he suddenly had a strong intuition. He had the illusion that his attack might be able to cross dimensions and affect the opponent's Information Form level. However, this feeling disappeared in a flash and could not be grasped.

"If I destroy the enemy's physical body and Information Form projection together, I'm afraid I can fundamentally eliminate the enemy's existence. This way, the Sanctum, the World Tree, the Underworld, and other methods might not be able to revive him."

Han Xiao thought to himself.

He suddenly had this idea mainly because of (Information Uniqueness — Conceptual Immortality). If all Transcendent Grade Supers had this ability, then the experts of the same level should have a countermeasure. If only Transcendent Grade Supers could kill Transcendent Grade Supers, then they should have lethality on the information and conceptual level.

"I've only stepped into the Transcendent Grade not long ago. It seems like there are still more hidden powers at this level that haven't been completely unlocked."

Han Xiao calmed himself down and flew back to the dynasty's flagship.

As soon as he returned to the command room, everyone turned to look at him with different expressions.

Han Xiao ignored him. He glanced at Gaud's expression and casually said,

"How is it? Are you happy to see your main body after so long?"

Gaud remained silent. He was filled with hatred, but he did not dare to speak, afraid that he would not be able to control his anger and confess.

Furthermore, Black Star's strength had already made him despair.

At this moment, Teny walked over with a complicated look in his eyes. Then, he became firm again and said with an unfriendly tone,

"Your Excellency Black Star, you've killed him. EsGod will soon become your hired thug. It's time for you to fulfill your end of the deal."

What hired thug?

Gaud was slightly stunned and confused.

However, no one answered his question. Han Xiao turned to look at Hella. Hella understood and showed the Mark of the Underworld, indicating that EsGod's soul had been sent into the Underworld.

Seeing this, Han Xiao smiled casually and replied, "Of course, of course.

"Of course, we each take what we need. I'll return this person to you."

Then, he lifted Gaud's body and threw it in front of Teny as if he was throwing trash.

Teny could not be bothered with Han Xiao's attitude. He asked someone to help Gaud up and sensed for a while. Suddenly, he realized that something was wrong with Gaud's condition.

"Sir Gaud, are you alright?"

"I …" Gaud clenched his teeth.

Without waiting for him to finish, Hella continued coldly, "We've already taken away his ability. He's now a cripple."

"What?"

Teny was shocked and hurriedly checked carefully. Only then did he confirm this. Furthermore, from the looks of the injuries, it was something that had happened recently. It was obvious that Black Star had done this not long before the deal. He could not help but be shocked and furious.

"Black Star! How dare you! "

"Take a break. Let Marbruce come out and talk to me. He should be watching."

Han Xiao ignored him.

Teny was stunned. He glared at Han Xiao and turned around to give some orders.

More than ten seconds later, a remote projection appeared. It was Marbruce, staring at Han Xiao with a gloomy expression.

"Black Star, this is not the deal we agreed on!"

"Is that so? But I remember that the deal only said to hand over the person. Isn't he in your hands now? "Han Xiao did not care.

"Stop quibbling. You know what I mean!"

Marbruce was furious.

They had made a deal with Black Star because they wanted to exchange for a direct descendant with Super High Risk Esper Abilities, not a cripple. The current situation made him feel as uncomfortable as if he had eaten a fly.

Energy control was an ability with a bright future. As long as he was nurtured well, he would definitely be able to enter the ranks of the top combatants. However, a direct Beyond Grade A with great potential was crippled just like that. Marbruce was so angry that smoke was about to come out of his mouth.

Not only him, but all the dynasty officers in the cabin had unfriendly expressions as they stared at Han Xiao and the others. They felt a common enemy for Gaud, a direct descendant of the dynasty. If not for the big picture, they would have fired directly.

"Alright, don't look like you have a deep grudge. We haven't finished talking yet." Han Xiao waved his hand. "Didn't you want an explanation?"

Marbruce suppressed his anger and shouted with a deep voice, "Speak, you better satisfy us."

"You think Gaud is a pure direct descendant of the dynasty, but his true identity is EsGod. When he was captured …"

Han Xiao could not be bothered to respond to his words. He slowly explained the split personality caused by (Esper Ability-Rebirth).

"… So what you're saying is that you killed Gaud and imprisoned him for so many years because he's an unstable factor and might have attracted the World Tree in advance? However, EsGod doesn't know about this doppelganger, and only Gaud knows his identity … Don't you think this is too ridiculous? "

Marbruce frowned.

Han Xiao's expression was calm. "I know you don't believe me. Anyway, I've already given you the person. If you have some courage, you can dig out evidence from him yourself."

It would be very difficult for him to use Gaud's memories as evidence. The dynasty would only think that it was fake. As a direct member who was in trouble, Gaud would not suffer the treatment of having his memories searched just because of the suspicion of an outsider. The three Universal Civilizations would not easily use such methods on direct members, as it would easily damage their loyalty. Furthermore, direct members would resist.

However, even if the dynasty was willing to search Gaud's memories, they would still suspect that he had done something and deliberately planted fake evidence. There was no way to completely prove Gaud's true identity, and Han Xiao did not care if the dynasty believed it or not.

As expected, Marbruce did not believe this saying at all. He only felt that it was Black Star's excuse. He said with a deep voice, "I'm very dissatisfied with this explanation. According to what you said, we have to thank you?"

"You should indeed thank me."

Han Xiao did not care. He could explain it properly, but there was no need for that.

Using this matter, he planned to change his previous image. Because he had cooperated with the three Universal Civilizations to fight against the enemies together, he had built a training base together and provided a lot of help, causing his image in the eyes of the three Universal Civilizations to become too righteous.

When he stepped into the Transcendent Grade, it was the most mysterious time. He could take this opportunity to increase the distance between them and strengthen his unpredictable image in the eyes of the three Universal Civilizations, making them feel that the increase in his strength had changed his personality. This was very common. This way, the three Universal Civilizations would be more careful in handling the relationship between the two sides and recalibrate their attitude toward him.

It was best not to be too sincere when interacting with these advanced civilizations. The upper echelons of both sides knew that they would be enemies sooner or later. It was useless to talk about making friends now.

Marbruce's breathing quickened. After a few seconds, he calmed down and said coldly, "We will investigate this matter internally and find out the truth as soon as possible."

He really wanted to fall out with him, but he did not dare. Even if the dynasty did so, Radiance and Ethereal would not go crazy with them.

"Up to you." Han Xiao waved his hand.

"… Also, you have to give me an explanation for crippling Gaud's Esper Ability. Don't tell me that it's still an unstable factor."

"That's right. If he continues to hold this power, there's a high chance that he'll participate in the war. With his special feelings for the World Tree, he might cause something we don't want to see … I know you don't have the courage to cripple a direct descendant, so I helped you solve this hidden danger. You still have to thank me."

"Black Star!" Marbruce laughed in anger. "Can you be more shameless?"

"I'm just telling the truth. It's your problem whether you accept it or not."

Han Xiao's tone was calm.

Marbruce clenched his fists so tightly that his knuckles turned white. After a while, he suppressed his anger and said with a deep voice,

"No matter what reason you have, it's too wasteful to lose a Super High Risk Esper Ability like Energy Control just like that! If we nurture it well, this ability will be a powerful way to deal with the World Tree. "

Black Star's strength, status, and influence made him feel helpless. He could only blame Han Xiao from a different perspective, and he was indeed very sad about the disappearance of the Super High Risk Esper Ability 'Energy Control'.

"I agree with you on this." Han Xiao nodded. "But don't worry, I didn't completely destroy this ability. It can still be used on the battlefield."

Marbruce was stunned. He subconsciously looked at Gaud, thinking that Han Xiao was talking about not castrating Gaud completely.

However, at this moment, Han Xiao patted Evans' shoulder and said, "I've already transplanted this ability to Evans. Compared to Gaud, his potential is more worth nurturing."

Hearing this, everyone looked over in unison, their faces full of doubt and surprise.

"The Energy Control Esper Ability was transferred to him?" Teny could not help but ask in surprise, "How did you do that? What kind of ability user is he? "

This was also what Marbruce was confused about. He stared straight at Han Xiao.

"I've been secretly nurturing Evans for decades." Han Xiao glanced at everyone and said, "His ability is exactly the same as EsGod's. They both absorb other people's Esper Abilities for their own use. It was through this method that he was able to seize Gaud's Esper Ability gene chain and obtain this Super High Risk ability."

As soon as he finished speaking, everyone was horrified and indescribably astounded.

EsGod was the nightmare of many organizations. Thankfully, he had already been killed, but now, there was another guy with the same ability in the universe. Could this galactic society still recover?

Marbruce's pupils constricted as he stared at Han Xiao. His heart was in turmoil.

Great! Black Star had been trying to nurture a second-generation EsGod since decades ago. Perhaps another goal of killing Gaud was to seize 'Energy Control'!

Now, Black Star had an EsGod Hero Spirit in his hands and a second-generation EsGod that he was secretly nurturing. Even he could not help but be shaken by this lineup.

As if he did not see everyone's expression, Han Xiao continued, "How is it? Evans' potential is better than Gaud's, right? Don't worry, I'll do my best to nurture him and let him play a role on the battlefield as soon as possible. So, Marbruce, you don't have to worry about wasting this ability. I'm a very thrifty person."

"… Then I'm relieved." Marbruce squeezed out a voice that sounded like he was chewing steel.

"Very good. Looks like our consensus has deepened. Since the matter is settled, I'll be leaving."

After Han Xiao said that, he turned around and left with the two of them without hesitation.

Teny looked at Han Xiao's back and could not help but whisper, "You've changed your mind.

"Black Star, you have changed …"

Han Xiao stopped in his tracks.

… If I don't change, am I waiting to be eaten up by you guys?

He did not say anything and continued to walk away.

Very soon, his vehicle drove out of the spaceport of the main ship and disappeared from everyone's sight.

Watching Han Xiao and the others leave, the people in the command room were still silent and had complicated feelings.

Marbruce's mood was gloomy. This change made his stomach sour and disgusted.

He really wanted to despise Black Star, but on second thought, he felt a little dejected. Only they had no right to despise him. If not for Black Star, the World Tree's iron hooves would have broken through the country's borders. The current situation would not have happened.

Although it was contradictory, he had no right to judge Black Star's character.

"… Take good care of Gaud. Heal his injuries first."

After saying that, Marbruce sighed and deactivated the remote projection.

Gaud watched the entire negotiation between Black Star and the dynasty. His expression kept changing, and his heart was filled with grief.

Originally, he still had a sliver of hope that the dynasty would stand up for his' unfair treatment 'and vent his anger on Black Star. However, the way the dynasty was restrained and tolerated in front of Black Star completely shattered his fantasy and his desire for revenge.

Even one of the three Universal Civilizations did not dare to provoke Black Star. Just what kind of position had this guy climbed to in the past few decades?!

In my current state, if I were to provoke Black Star again, it would be like striking a rock with an egg.

Gaud lamented in his heart. It was as if his bones had been sucked out.

However, he still had one doubt. He turned to look at Teny and whispered, "You guys said that you were talking about EsGod.

"You guys said that Black Star turned EsGod into a fighter. What's going on? Isn't EsGod dead?"

Teny looked at him with a complicated expression.

Black Star said that Gaud was EsGod. Although he did not believe it, he could not help but be a little wary.

Teny thought for a while before replying, "You were imprisoned for a while.

"You've been locked up for decades, so you might not know this, but Black Star has subdued a pair of sisters. The Esper Abilities of these sisters are exactly the same as the Life and Death Sisters in history. They have also opened up the Underworld Dimension and can turn the Undead into Hero Spirits to serve as their subordinates. Although EsGod was killed, his soul was thrown into the Underworld Dimension and became their subordinate. Now, there should be more than ten Beyond Grade A Hero Spirits."

As soon as he said that, Gaud's eyes widened.

…

On the other side, in the Underworld Dimension.

EsGod slowly opened his eyes, and a pitch-black, boundless land appeared in front of him.

"Am I dead …"

EsGod lowered his head and saw that his body had turned into a translucent spirit state. He could not help but mutter to himself.

The scene before his death appeared again. The overwhelming sword light had killed the life force of all his cells in one strike, making him tremble from the depths of his soul. He could not help but reminisce.

However, not long after, he realized that his condition was not right. His soul was clearly like a candle in the wind, but it did not show any signs of dissipating. Instead, it became more and more solid.

Whoosh!

At this time, a few rays of light flashed. Han Xiao and the others used the King to teleport to the surroundings and flew in front of EsGod.

"What did you do to me?"

EsGod frowned.

"Don't worry, it's a good thing for you. Do you really think I can bear to kill you?" Han Xiao chuckled.

"… What are you doing?"

"Don't worry, it's a good thing for you. This is the Underworld. It can stabilize souls. It …"

Before Han Xiao could finish, EsGod's eyes widened, and he interrupted him with a surprised tone.

"The legendary Underworld?!"

"Oh? You know? "Han Xiao paused and raised his brows.

"Of course I know."

EsGod nodded. As a collector of Super High Risk Esper Abilities, he had collected the information of all the Beyond Grade A Esper in history.

And such amazing people like the Life and Death sisters were naturally the focus of his attention. Thus, he had seen all the records of the Underworld.

"That's easy. It saves me the time to explain." Han Xiao smiled. "The Life and Death Esper Abilities of this generation all have masters. They repaired the Underworld and restored the effects in history. You're already an undead now. Are you willing to accept the transformation of the Underworld and become an eternal Hero Spirit?"

Hesitation flashed across EsGod's eyes. If he could live, he did not want to die. However, joining the Underworld was equivalent to losing his freedom. He would probably never be free.

Seeing this, Han Xiao smiled and said, "I know your concerns. This is actually not a bad thing. You should know your own lifespan better than me. You don't have long to live anyway. As long as you give up a part of your freedom, you can live forever in the Underworld. Furthermore, your body will change, and you won't have to worry about the pressure of your genetic chain anymore. Your combat strength will only be stronger than when you were alive.

Why not? "EsGod's eyes flickered, and he suddenly said with a deep voice," Black Star, we've known each other for many years. Although you stepped into a higher level first, my goal has not changed. If I join the Underworld, I won't have the chance to advance any further. "

"You don't have the chance to begin with. Even if I don't kill you, you won't be able to advance. Don't doubt my judgment. As someone who's been through it, I know better than you what it takes to advance."

Han Xiao shook his head.

He was not lying. EsGod's genetic chain was overloaded, and his life form would be even more unstable during his Promotion. Furthermore, with his terrible relationships, no pinnacle Beyond Grade A would be willing to help him advance. It would be difficult for him to fulfill the three requirements.

Seeing that EsGod was silent, Han Xiao thought for a while and smiled.

"However, you don't have to be discouraged. Your dream can be fulfilled by your heir."

"Heir?" EsGod was confused.

Han Xiao waved his hand and got Evans to come over.

"This guy is called Evans. He inherited your ability and can take the Esper Abilities of others. Can't he inherit your will and help you see the scenery at a higher level?"

"The same ability as me?"

EsGod was shocked and sized Evans up carefully.

Evans also displayed his ability at the right time, proving that Han Xiao was not lying.

Seeing this, EsGod was even more shocked.

"You … can't be my illegitimate son, right?"

Evans' face darkened, but he did not say anything.

Han Xiao smiled and said, "How would I know?"

"Let me think …"

EsGod frowned and fell into his memories.

When he was wreaking havoc in the galaxy, he had naturally found females of different species to vent his desires. However, they were all left to fend for themselves after mating. He did not know if they left behind any children.

The more he thought about it, the more EsGod felt like he was missing a part of his memories.

This time, Han Xiao said, "There's no need to be so conflicted. The probability of having the same Esper Ability is even rarer than having children, not to mention an extremely rare ability like yours. With my nurturing, Evans did not take the wrong path. Although he has few abilities now, his talent is not inferior to yours. Why don't you nurture him and let him fulfill your wish? "

EsGod was silent for a while before he suddenly laughed and said with a teasing tone, "To put it bluntly, you just want me to help you nurture your combat strength and work for you."

Han Xiao did not stand on ceremony. "Evans has too little combat experience and doesn't know how to use his various abilities. This is your strength, so please guide him."

"… I haven't promised you yet."

"Do you have a choice?" Han Xiao raised his brows.

"Heh, that's what I admire the most about you."

EsGod laughed for some reason, looked at Evans, nodded, and slowly said, "Life is unpredictable.

"Life is really unpredictable. This is the first time I'm teaching someone. Alright, I'll teach you how to use this ability to fight. I only have one request … if one day, you can step into a higher level, help me beat up Black Star."

"Oh, how scary." Han Xiao clicked his tongue.

Evans looked at Han Xiao and then at EsGod. Seeing that both of them were staring at him, he finally nodded hesitantly.

Seeing this, EsGod opened his arms with a calm expression.

"Come, turn me into a Hero Spirit. Let this world see what I look like without any burden!"
